The EU AI Act and the Frontier AI Safety Commitments support multi-stakeholder GPAI evaluation portability in the following two ways:

1. The EU AI Act outlines that at least three distinct parties may run GPAI evaluations: GPAI providers, the EU AI Office, and qualified independent experts on behalf of the AI Office. This multi-party involvement facilitates the implementation and assessment of evaluations across different institutions.

2. The Frontier AI Safety Commitments encourage signatories to consider results from both internal and external evaluations, including those conducted by independent third-party evaluators and other bodies deemed appropriate by their governments. This commitment to external evaluations promotes collaboration and scrutiny, enhancing the portability of GPAI evaluations.
